title: Petition of the Reading Municipal Light Department for authorization and approval of an increase in the rate of depreciation from the statutory rate of three percent to four percent for the year 2000.
filings: ORDER issued. Commissioner participating were: James Connelly, Chairman; Commissioners W. Robert Keating, Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr., Paul b. Vasington and Deirdre K. Manning. (DTE 00-32-I)
